_help: Left pads ("url") open on the Echo itself; right pads ("pc") open on your PC and need a unique "id". A "url" is an https:// link or a page from this folder like timer.html. Each side has room for 4 pads. "icon" is the logo shown (find more at icon-sets.iconify.design); "name" is never shown, only read out by screen readers. "window" (optional, PC pads) is the program's name as in Task Manager's Details tab, like Obsidian.exe: the helper uses it to bring the app to the front. "reuse": true brings back the app's open window instead of opening another one (for apps like Terminal that open a new window each time). After editing, run sync_echo.py (copies the deck to the Echo) and restart the deck helper.
